subject: Save output from UI dynamically created within a loop that runs a module

messages.author: 4fadfdde0c51e523
messages.subject: Save output from UI dynamically created within a loop that runs a module
parts:
I am trying to have the user create a dynamic number of numeric inputs based on an initial selected numeric input value.  To do this, I have created a module that  makes a numeric input widget and using renderUI inside an observer have attempted to call the module n number of times based on the user initial selected numeric input value.  I can successfully run the module, I however cannot save the values of each created numeric input widget.  I'm trying to use the values in some sort of list structure downstream in my application.  I have posted a working example of what I'm trying to achieve without using a module.  I have also posted an example module that I'd like to run.  Any suggestions would be awesome!

http://stackoverflow.com/q/42633078/3018211

module:

#module
NumberUI <- function(id){
  ns <- NS(id)
  numericInput(ns("obs"), "Observations:", 10, min = 1, max = 100)
}

Number <- function(input, output, session){}


working example without module:

library(shiny)


ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Old Faithful Geyser Data"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      numericInput("numInputs", "How many inputs do you want", 4),
      # place to hold dynamic inputs
      uiOutput("inputGroup")
    ),
    # this is just a demo to show the input values
    mainPanel(textOutput("inputValues"),
              textOutput('final')
    )

  )
))

server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  # observe changes in "numInputs", and create corresponding number of inputs
observeEvent(input$numInputs, {
    output$inputGroup = renderUI({
      input_list <- lapply(1:input$numInputs, function(i) {
        # for each dynamically generated input, give a different name
        inputName <- paste("input", i, sep = "")
        numericInput(inputName, inputName, 1)
      })
    })
  })


#access variable test outside of observer
  test <- reactive({
    paste(lapply(1:input$numInputs, function(i) {
      inputName <- paste("input", i, sep = "")
      input[[inputName]]
    }))
  })

  #####this is the output I want#######
  output$final <- renderPrint({test()})

})

shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.subject: Re: Save output from UI dynamically created within a loop that runs a module
parts: numericInput("numInputs", "How many inputs do you want", 4),

uiOutput("inputGroup"),
  textOutput('final')
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$numInputs, {
    output$inputGroup = renderUI({
      lapply(1:input$numInputs, function(i) {
        NumberUI(i)
      })
    })
  })
  
  test <- reactive({
    unlist(lapply(1:input$numInputs, function(i) {
      callModule(Number, as.character(i))()
    }))
  })

output$final <- renderPrint({
    test()
  })
}

parts: I only skimmed this thread but this jumped out at me:

observeEvent(input$numInputs, {
    output$inputGroup = renderUI({
      lapply(1:input$numInputs, function(i) {
        NumberUI(i)
      })
    })
  })

should just be:

    output$inputGroup <- renderUI({
      lapply(1:input$numInputs, NumberUI)
    })

The main thing is the observeEvent going away, the simplification of lapply is just a nice bonus (assuming it works, I haven't actually run this code).
